# Simple Consulting

> Simple Consulting is a Toronto e-commerce and marketplace consultancy run by Scott Nguyen. It provides hands-on Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy, Costco and Shopify channel management for brands, manufacturers and distributors in Canada and the US.

Scott Nguyen has 17+ years in retail and e-commerce, including nine years at Staples Canada and senior e-commerce roles at consumer-product companies. Clients work with him directly. Credentials: Lean Six Sigma (University of Toronto), Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications, CompTIA A+. Business: 17700679 Canada Inc. o/a Simple Consulting. Contact: scott@simpleconsulting.ca.

## Results (client names confidential)
- $700K → $3M+: Grew an established brand’s sales more than fourfold in one year. Channels: Amazon Seller Central (US & CA) · Amazon Vendor Central (US & CA) · Costco.ca · Wayfair Canada & US · Walmart.ca.
- $20K → $6M: Grew a brand from $20K to $6M in sales in one year. Channels: Walmart.ca · Walmart.com · BestBuy.ca · Shopify · Amazon FBA Canada · Lowe’s Canada & US · Overstock · Groupon · Loblaws.
- $0 → $2M: Took a newly started company to $2M in sales in 18 months. Channels: Amazon Seller Central Canada · BestBuy.ca · Shopify · Groupon.
- eBay recovery channel for a retail chain: 200K+ items sold in 3 years, 99.7% positive feedback, 24K followers.

## Services
- [Amazon management](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/amazon-management.html): You need a hands-on Amazon consultant to manage ongoing account tasks, coordinate an internal team or diagnose a specific Seller Central or Vendor Central issue.
- [Walmart management](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/walmart-management.html): You are preparing a Walmart launch, taking over an existing account or finding the daily work is getting ahead of your team.
- [Reimbursement reviews](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/reimbursement-recovery.html): You have an unresolved shipment, return, inventory or fee discrepancy and need a clear view of the records.
- [Inventory & fulfilment](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/ecommerce-operations.html): Inventory or fulfilment problems keep interrupting your team across marketplaces, Shopify or retail.
- [Shopify & DTC](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/shopify-consulting.html): For product brands launching a store or improving an existing Shopify business.
- [Fractional e-commerce support](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/fractional-ecommerce-manager.html): For founders and teams coordinating several channels without a dedicated senior e-commerce lead.
- [Systems & reporting](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/ecommerce-systems-reporting.html): For brands with manual reporting, disconnected order and inventory data, or an ERP project to scope.
- [Google Ads & Shopping](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/google-ads-management.html): For Canadian product and service businesses seeking a focused campaign review or scoped ongoing support.
- [Channel diagnostic](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/channel-diagnostic.html): CAD $750 review of one marketplace channel (listings, advertising, inventory, account health) with a written priority plan.
- [Free store check](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/store-check.html): free automated report on an online store or an Amazon, Walmart or Best Buy listing, with fixes.
- [Store & listing rebuild](https://www.simpleconsulting.ca/store-check.html#rebuild): fixed-fee project to fix the issues the store check finds.
